long_biography.plain_text:
Trained in econometrics, strategic marketing and accountancy, Kashiouris began his career with financial institutions in London. He established Terra Capital in 2000 as a property-focused investment business and later developed a network of British real-estate companies. Several of those entities remain under his controlling ownership rather than merely his directorship.

In 2010, he co-founded the trading group known through the IronFX brand and subsequently held its senior executive and board positions. More recently, Kashiouris became the verified controlling shareholder of Ultimate Traders Evaluation, with at least three quarters of its shares and voting rights. This newer interest keeps financial trading central to his present portfolio, while Terra remains a substantial parallel strand. His corporate control does not make the underlying property, brokerage accounts, client funds or company balances personal assets. No consolidated personal valuation or reliable comparison of every private holding is available.
